title: Entity
description: A registered legal company. One per file, at entities/<country>/<id>.yaml.

id.description: Stable slug, prefix e_. Also the filename.

name.description: The exact legal name as the national register prints it, legal form included.

former_names.description: Earlier legal names, as a register records them.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of registration. Also the directory name.

parent.description: The entity that directly owns this one. Omit when not established; null only when a source confirms there is no owner. See docs/fields.md.

parent_exception.description: A source says a direct owner exists but does not disclose it. Mutually exclusive with parent.

ultimate_parent.description: The entity at the top of the chain. Same four states as parent, and independent of it.

ultimate_parent_exception.description: A source says the top of the chain exists but does not disclose it. Mutually exclusive with ultimate_parent.

lei.description: GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier. Check digits are validated.

registry_id.description: National register number, as the register prints it. Required when the only qualifying source is a register citation.

sources.description: At least one URL or register citation (<country>/<register>: <identifier>). Label text alone is not enough.

notes.description: Optional, 1-2 sentences. Only for a fact that stops the next editor making a wrong change the validator cannot catch.

verified_on.description: ISO 8601 date on which a person last checked this record against its sources.

example.description: true if this file is a template rather than curated data.
